subject: EU Launch: request for seat authorization and conditional offer approval
messages:
From: Olivia Hart <olivia@novametrics.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novametrics.com
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 09:14:00 +0000
Subject: Headcount for EU pilot - seats, offer timing, and contracting

Hi Sean,

Hope you’re well — we’re ramping up preparations for our EU product launch and want to lock in the Redwood seats you quoted during last week’s call. Our initial ask: 3 Account Executives (EMEA-focused), 2 Solutions Engineers, and 1 Customer Success Manager regionally allocated to Dublin.

We’ve started procurement and contracting but procurement asked for an internal resource confirmation: will Redwood be able to issue conditional offer letters for the 3 SEs/AEs tied to our contract signature milestone (DocuSign link preferred)? They want to show candidate offers in their budget packet.

Attaching a quick headcount plan and our preferred offer template. Can you confirm whether this is doable and, if so, who we should expect to see in the offer approvals queue at Redwood? Also any constraints on comp bands for EMEA hires would be helpful — our recruiting team needs ranges.

Thanks — Olivia
Olivia Hart
VP, Global Partnerships
Nova Metrics
[attachment: eu_headcount_plan_q3.xlsx] [attachment: nova_metrics_conditional_offer_template.docx]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Hart <olivia@novametrics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 12:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Headcount for EU pilot - seats, offer timing, and contracting

Hi Olivia — thanks for the context and the attachments.

Short answer: we can provision the seats and support conditional offers, but I need internal authorization on the AE/SE headcount (3 AEs / 2 SEs / 1 CSM) and clarity on whether these roles are Redwood-employed (we’ll supply candidate offers) vs. contractor-managed by Nova. Assuming Redwood hires, we can align on comp bands and produce conditional offer letters tied to the DocuSign milestone you referenced.

Internal next steps: I’ll loop in Marissa for headcount approval and Laura to review EMEA comp band guidance. Vivek — can you weigh in on whether we have spare GFEs (headcount budget) in Q3 to support these roles without displacing other hires?

Sean
Sean Gallagher
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 08:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Headcount for EU pilot - seats, offer timing, and contracting

Thanks Sean. Rapid notes after reviewing the attached plan:

- We have 2 uncommitted GTM seats in the EMEA expansion bucket; approving 3 AEs + 2 SEs + 1 CSM is a net +4 seats (overcommit of 2).
- Proposed path: authorize 2 AEs and 1 SE immediately (conditional offers tied to signing), and schedule the remaining AE + 1 SE + CSM as contingent hires that convert on either: 1) revenue milestone with Nova (net new ARR >= $150k in 90 days) OR 2) internal OKR trigger (regional ARR > $250k).
- Comp bands: Laura — please confirm EMEA bands and localized benefits impact; we’ll apply a 5% uplift for Dublin market.

If leadership signs off on the conditional path, we can issue conditional offer templates quickly and align recruiting timelines. Sean — need a short one-pager you can share with Nova procurement that spells the conditional language and the conversion triggers.

Marissa
VP, GTM Operations

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2026 10:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Headcount for EU pilot - seats, offer timing, and contracting

Quick comp band guidance for Dublin hires (summary):

- AE (EMEA, quota-bearing): base range €70,000 - €95,000 + OTE 60% - 80% depending on level; relocation stipend variable.
- SE (senior): base range €85,000 - €115,000; expectation: technical onsite support of initial onboardings.
- CSM: base range €60,000 - €80,000 + performance bonus tied to retention metrics.

Apply +5% cost-of-living uplift and standard European benefits package (pension contributions where applicable). For conditional offers: HR recommends a 90-day conversion window and explicit language that offer is contingent on Nova Metrics contract signature and receipt of agreed initial payment.

I also attached a short draft clause for the conditional offer that legal can finalize.

[quoted: eu_headcount_plan_q3.xlsx]

Laura
Head of Total Rewards

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2026 15:32:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Headcount for EU pilot - seats, offer timing, and contracting

I ran the numbers against the Q3 hiring plan. Key points:

- We can flex 2 seats from the EMEA expansion bucket without impacting planned hires, but approving the full request upfront would require shifting one seat from Q4 to Q3 or an additional one-off budget request.
- Suggest the conditional approach Marissa outlined. Approve: 2 AEs + 1 SE now; contingency for the remaining roles.
- If leadership approves the contingency triggers, finance will pre-authorize conditional offer letters that explicitly state the conversion criteria and the expected payment milestone (invoice #1 cleared).

I’ll draft the brief one-pager for procurement and include the finance escrow language. Sean — I can share a version by EOD Friday.

Vivek
VP, Finance Operations
